required_behavior: E1 step 0 (no real model): capture the exact provider request payload OMP 18.4.5 builds for the openai-codex provider (Responses API) with a local capture server (the earlier smoke-fix worker used api openai-codex-responses with a fake HOME); record where the delivered user message (with the delivery identity markers) appears (e.g. input[] items with content[].text of type input_text).

E1 fix: make bridge.ts providerRequestContainsActiveDelivery (and any sibling identity checks) recognise the active delivery in every payload shape OMP uses (chat messages, Responses input items, string or content-array forms) without weakening the identity rules (exact ids, no false positives from history/older deliveries); keep the existing verified behaviour for the shapes already covered. Add TS tests with captured payload fixtures for each shape (redact nothing secret - the fixtures must not contain tokens; build them from the local capture).

E2: decide from the CW-10 contract whether all three criteria are really required; if the verified contract requires them, document exactly in the to_worker tool description and the to-worker skill (what each means, how to choose result_file); if not, accept any subset with at least one and document it. Do not weaken verified judge semantics.

E3: when an experiment run fails to start (start_failed / run_start_failed / held reasons that end the attempt), proactively deliver a short notice message to the manager (when it is idle, via the existing delivery path, once) in addition to notices[]; the Task state and worker state stay consistent.
E4: a Task that never ran shows a status like '[시작 실패 · <reason>]' instead of '보고 완료'.
acceptance: red->green tests (TS fixtures for E1 in each payload shape; backend tests for E2/E3; UI test for E4)

no-model live check: two real OMPs with a local provider that mimics the openai-codex Responses payload (or the captured shape) -> experiment run starts (OMP_PROCESSED observed), host shell run, review, judge, report
run tests/backend, tests/bridge, TS bridge + g3_omp tests, tests/contracts, tests/ui, tests/workflow (real exit codes, no pipes, venv python)
rules: No real provider requests (local capture/scripted provider only); OMP only with the Workbench home or a fake HOME; never read credential contents or other processes' environ; temp dirs only under /tmp; kill only PIDs you started; never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or the user's processes or configs; no commits, no graphify update. If the fix requires weakening a verified identity rule, stop and report.
result_format: checks table first, status, step-0 payload facts, fix summary per item, changed paths + sha256, residue. Korean, <=20 lines.
